title: Corporate Expense Rule Engine
description_html:
Given expenses {expense_id, trip_id, expense_type, vendor_type, amount_usd}, return the ones that break a policy rule.

Levels

  1. Part 1: base rules
    • No Entertainment expenses
    • Restaurant expenses over $75
    • Any single expense over $250
    • A trip total over $2,000
    • A trip's meal total over $200
  2. Parts 2–3: more rules
    • New rule types are added in later parts; the evaluator must take them without a rewrite

Constraints / rules

  • amount_usd arrives as a string.

Progressive round: each level unlocks after the previous one passes. Write level 1 so later levels extend it rather than rewrite it.

Source: Candidate-reported Rippling coding round (prep-site write-ups, 2025–26). Candidate-reported; exact wording varies between reports.
